operational_audit.interpretation: The free-primary judge policy was rate-limited and produced a mixed-judge partial run. V10 pins the paid route as the only judge and fails a shard instead of changing models.

answer_context_support_coverage_for_19_e.interpretation: Most failures were evidence binding, synthesis, temporal interpretation, or exact-value rendering errors rather than gross support-session recall failures.

v10_repairs: Turn-first role-specific candidate search followed by bounded chronological dialogue expansion.
Separate session limits: 12 for assistant/user and 18 for preference, instead of V9's 40 preference bundles.
Preference contrast, stable-identity, profession, goal, and negative-constraint binding.
Focused synonym queries and action normalization for buy/purchase/got/own/acquired, occupation, battery, reading, decisions, and competitions.
Explicit event dates override discussion timestamps; relative-time matching binds the requested action.
Historical before/previous questions use the immediately preceding state when both states are present.
Latest accepted assistant decision overrides earlier proposals.
Exact deterministic labeled sums and exact scalar rendering without unsupported qualifiers.
Output-limit detection retries with a concise FINAL-only contract.
HTTP 402 is fatal at request and shard levels; stale fatal markers from older log attempts are ignored.

offline_retrieval_checks.interpretation: Every observed missing/low-ranked support session now enters the bounded pre-answer pool while remaining below the frozen 40000-token answer-context cap.

acceptance.reason: Only a fresh complete V10 180-item run can verify the target. The interrupted V9 directory must not be resumed under changed code.
